name: Shoal Halfling
printedArtCredit: Drew Baker, Seacliff dwarf and shoal halfling, p. 45.
sourceDistinctions: Page 46 inherits the Player’s Handbook Halfling except for listed changes. The all-saves bonus, fear bonus, and Listen bonus remain.
The variant loses the racial attack bonus with thrown weapons and slings and racial Climb, Jump, and Move Silently bonuses. The separate Small size attack bonus remains.
The Shoal Halfling Patrol has a group encounter level rather than an individual challenge rating.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Stormwrack errata file. The official FAQ has no Shoal Halfling entry.
portraitForm: Tess Siltstep, an original Shoal Halfling Rogue
